Most advice on this topic is vague. This guide is a field note: what to change on your site this week so you stand out for the right reasons.

undefined

This guide is for people building a recognizable personal brand who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

undefined

Do this next

  1. Consistent name + photo across LinkedIn and site
  2. One-line positioning under your name
  3. Same URL everywhere you show up online

Make uniqueness visible

Your uniqueness is already in your projects and judgment. The website’s job is to frame that judgment so a stranger trusts it quickly.

How a website helps you stand out

Brand isn’t a logo — it’s the feeling someone gets when they land on your page and instantly understand what you care about.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Consistent name + photo across LinkedIn and site
  • One-line positioning under your name
  • Same URL everywhere you show up online

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
